advancements.lacuna.forge_eclipser.title: Blade of the Eclipse
advancements.lacuna.its_a_wrap.descripti: Mummify a creature with Starlace Bandages.
advancements.lacuna.its_a_wrap.title: It's a Wrap
advancements.lacuna.link_pearl.descripti: Split a Fractured Pearl into its linked shards.
advancements.lacuna.link_pearl.title: Two Halves
advancements.lacuna.root.description: Find your first ruby: the world remembers more than it shows.
advancements.lacuna.root.title: Lacuna
advancements.lacuna.shooting_star.descri: See a star fall from the clear night sky on its own.
advancements.lacuna.shooting_star.title: Shooting Star
advancements.lacuna.survive_banishment.d: Come back from the Forgotten Land.
advancements.lacuna.triangle_of_instant_: Turn a creature to dust with the Ember Triangle.
advancements.lacuna.village_friend.descr: Become Friendly with a village: trade, defend it, ring its bell at dawn.
advancements.lacuna.village_friend.title: A Friend of the Village
advancements.lacuna.which_one_is_real.de: Hide among copies of yourself with a Totem of Confusion.
advancements.lacuna.wish_upon_a_star.des: Call a falling star down with the Starcaller Trumpet.
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use: Use a Chronal Shard: +%s s of sand, up to %s min (sneak: pour in the whole stack)
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use2: While the sand runs, time within %2$s blocks flows %1$sx faster: furnaces, crops, grass, saplings, ice melting, copper aging, young animals, eggs
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use3: A redstone signal holds the sand; comparators read the time left
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use4: Water and lava flow %1$sx faster; players heal %2$sx faster and shake off harmful effects sooner
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use5: Redstone timing, spawners, portals and other hourglasses are never affected
death.attack.lacuna.echo_strike.player: %1$s was struck by the echo of %2$s's blade
death.attack.lacuna.eclipse_cleave: %1$s was swept away by an eclipse shockwave
death.attack.lacuna.falling_star: %1$s was struck by a falling star called by %2$s
death.attack.lacuna.falling_star.item: %1$s was struck by a falling star called by %2$s with %3$s
death.attack.lacuna.falling_star.player: %1$s was struck by a falling star while fighting %2$s
death.attack.lacuna.gravemaw_wave: %1$s was swallowed by a crescent wave
death.attack.lacuna.pyrrhic_bolt: %1$s was hit by a pyrrhic bolt
death.attack.lacuna.reflection_touch.pla: %1$s met their own reflection while fighting %2$s
death.attack.lacuna.shooting_star: %1$s was struck by a shooting star
death.attack.lacuna.shooting_star.player: %1$s was struck by a shooting star while fighting %2$s
death.attack.lacuna.solar_beam: %1$s was burned by a focused sunbeam
death.attack.lacuna.solar_ray.player: %1$s was erased by %2$s's fury of the sun
death.attack.lacuna.tidal_wave: %1$s was swept away by a tidal wave
death.attack.lacuna.tidal_wave.player: %1$s was swept away by %2$s's tidal wave
death.attack.lacuna.umbral_rend: %1$s was torn open by umbral shadows
death.attack.lacuna.umbral_rend.player: %1$s was rent apart by %2$s's umbral blade
effect.lacuna.shadow_walk.description: A shadow that passes through walls, unseen. Click a creature or player to possess it until it casts you out.
item.lacuna.arrival_shard.lore: The right half. It wants to stay.
item.lacuna.arrival_shard.use: Use: throw; it anchors where it lands.
item.lacuna.chiseled_exilite.tip: The totem's open hand, carved into its own stone; a pearl glints where the ruby was.
item.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.tip: Every grain is a borrowed second.
item.lacuna.chronoshard_pocket_watch.lor: It ticks a little behind the world.
item.lacuna.clockwork_decoy.tip: Throw it: monsters chase the mannequin for 15 s.
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.tip: One thing at a time. It's large, not infinite.
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use: Empty: use on a creature, a cart or a boat to stuff it inside
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use2: Empty: sneak + use on a block to bag it, contents and all
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use3: Full: use on a block face to let it out, exactly as it went in
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use4: Empty: use on a player to carry them off for a while (PvP only)
item.lacuna.departure_shard.lore: The left half. It wants to go back.
item.lacuna.departure_shard.use: Use: travel to the linked anchor (same dimension).
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.lore: Sunlight remembers where it was told to go.
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.use: Hold use: focus a burning beam of light.
item.lacuna.echo_fragment.tip: A memory that refused to fade.
item.lacuna.eclipser.dash: Dash: %s to %s damage to every foe in its path; the air wake hurls them aside
item.lacuna.eclipser.lore: Where it cuts, the light forgets to return.
item.lacuna.ember.tip: Burns for a very long time.
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.lore: Three embers that swore never to go out.
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.pvp: Other players only when PvP is on
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.repair: Repair at an anvil with Ember (+%s uses each)
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.spare: Spares you, your pets, villagers, golems and peaceful animals
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.use: Use: Thermal Wave (%s blocks around you)
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.use_detail: Hostile creatures and anything hunting you are pulverized on the spot
item.lacuna.exilite.tip: Calcite stained by a single shard. Polish it, cut it into bricks, carve the hand into it.
item.lacuna.exilite_block.tip: Nine Exilite Ingots, pressed together. A beacon base; never burns.
item.lacuna.exilite_debris.tip: The buried remains of the stone the Totem of Banishing was carved from. Hidden deep in the Forgotten Land, never in the open, and rarely. Needs a diamond pickaxe; no explosion breaks it. Smelt it for a shard.
item.lacuna.exilite_ingot.tip: Between two crying obsidian: two Forgotten Portal Frames, no rubies needed. Nine: a Block of Exilite. Never burns.
item.lacuna.exilite_shard.tip: Smelted from Exilite Debris. Four shards and four gold ingots: an Exilite Ingot. One in a ring of calcite: eight blocks of Exilite.
item.lacuna.extinguished_star_rock.tip: A spent star, grey and cratered like the Moon. Mined, it gives at most one Star Fragment.
item.lacuna.forgotten_portal_frame.tip: Eight frames, two per side with the corners empty, around a 2×2 opening: touch one with the Totem of Banishing.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.lore: Two halves that never stopped looking for each other.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.use: Use: split into an Arrival and a Departure shard.
item.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.lore: It has eaten the light of many graves.
item.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.use: Stand still and hold use: release a crescent wave
item.lacuna.guild_board.tip: Join a guild or take a contract.
item.lacuna.heartwood_bow.use: Arrows sprout grasping roots that hold whatever they catch
item.lacuna.heartwood_bow.use2: Hit targets are rooted (longer against a wall)
item.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.lore: Every reflection remembers the last one.
item.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.use: Hold: reflect projectiles. Sneak + use: release a stored echo.
item.lacuna.molten_star_rock.tip: Fresh from the sky: burns to stand on and cools to Prime Star Rock in a minute or two, at once in water or rain. Mined now: only 1-2 Star Fragments, rarely a Solar Flare Fragment.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.lore: It shines a light nobody can see by.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.recharge: Recharge: click an Ender Pearl (+50%%) or an Echo Shard (+100%%) onto it, or use one on the placed lantern.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.use: Held or placed: hostile mobs ignore you and cannot hurt you (placed: anyone within 12 blocks).
item.lacuna.obelisk_inscription.tip: The names move when you look away.
item.lacuna.prime_star_rock.tip: The star at its best: mine it with a pickaxe for 1-3 Star Fragments (Fortune helps). It chimes softly, and burns out after about three days.
item.lacuna.pyrrhic_scepter.use: Use: pay 2 health for a homing bolt
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.lore: Lend a heart, and still things wake.
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.use: Use on a dropped item, or with an item in your off hand: pay 2 health to bring it to life for %s s
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.use2: It fights for you with its own gifts: blades slash, bows shoot, food feeds you, TNT goes off
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.use3: Then it falls asleep again, just as it was. Up to %s awake at once
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.use4: Sneak + use on your animated item: it falls asleep early
item.lacuna.quickening_wand.use5: Bows, greatswords, the Eclipser, sickles, trumpets and other gifted items sometimes use their own powers
item.lacuna.repair_kit.use: Use with a damaged item in the other hand: restores 25%%.
item.lacuna.silk_dust.tip: Right click a surface to leave a fading glow.
item.lacuna.star_fragment.tip: Still warm from the fall. Mends the Starcaller Trumpet, weaves Starlace.
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.blast: Small blast: up to %s damage, knockback, fire; leaves a Molten Star Rock
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.crater: Cracks the ground only when mobGriefing is on
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.lock: Aim at a creature: the star locks on and follows it as it falls
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.lore: Sound it, and a star answers.
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.repair: Repair at an anvil with Star Fragments
item.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.use: Use: call a falling star down where you look (up to %s blocks)
item.lacuna.starlace.lore: Zenithite thread that still remembers the night sky.
item.lacuna.starlace.starfall: Starfall (%s): land from over %s blocks unharmed, in a shockwave of starlight that strikes nearby foes
item.lacuna.starlace.starlit: Starlit (each piece): +%s%% speed at night under the open sky, or in the End
item.lacuna.starlace.step: Constellation Step (%s): press jump in mid-air to leap again
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.hurry: Finish within %s s, or the wraps come loose
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.mummy: Mummy: frozen, silent and harmless, never despawns, takes %s%% less damage
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.refuse: Players and mighty creatures can't be wrapped
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.shears: Shears unwrap it as it was; some bandages come back
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.tip: Strips of starlace: what they bind lies still and silent.
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.use: Use on a creature: wrap it into a mummy
item.lacuna.starlace_bandage.wraps: Peaceful: 1 bandage; hostile or large: 2; large and hostile: 3
item.lacuna.starlace_boots.glide: Sneak while falling: glide on starlight
item.lacuna.sunken_bell.tip: Ring it to hear the ores answer.
item.lacuna.suns_fury.lore: A noon that was never allowed to end.
item.lacuna.suns_fury.use: Use: hold to draw back, release to throw. Single use. The sun answers where it lands.
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.charges: The tide rises with hits in water or rain, waves that strike and time spent in water
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.lore: It remembers every tide that ever turned.
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.maelstrom: Sneak + use with %s tide charges: Maelstrom
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.maelstrom_: A whirlpool drags foes in and drowns them for %s s, then bursts into a geyser
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.melee: Hits drench the target; +%s damage while you are in water or rain
item.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.wave_detai: A wall of water rolls %s blocks ahead, sweeping foes away (%s damage), dousing fire and quenching lava
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.lore: A stone hand that remembers a land no one else does.
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.portal: Use on a ring of Forgotten Portal Frames: light the portal.
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.use: Use: enter the Forgotten Land in a blast that throws everything nearby back, at both ends (or leave it early). Strike: hurl the target away and banish it.
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.wear: Wears out after 6 uses; it cannot be repaired.
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.copies: %s hits break a copy; they fade after %s s
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.lore: Five of you. Only one is real.
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.lure: Hostile mobs hunting you are drawn to them
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.mimic: They copy your every move: walk, sprint, jump, sneak, swing, each on its own heading
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.swap: %s%% chance you swap places with one of them, else you stay in their midst
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.tip: Only you are told whether you swapped.
item.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.use: Hold use: %s copies of you appear around you
item.lacuna.umbral_steel.nightforged: Nightforged: mines %s faster where light is %s or less
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_axe.cleave: Eclipse Cleave: charged hits release a shadow shockwave
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_axe.cleave_deta: Foes within %2$s blocks take %1$s of the hit and are thrown back
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_axe.lore: Each swing is a small eclipse.
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_pickaxe.lore: It digs best where no light has ever been.
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_shovel.lore: The deeper the dark, the softer the earth.
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_sword.lore: It drinks the light from every wound.
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_sword.rend: Umbral Rend: every third hit tears the shadow open
item.lacuna.umbral_steel_sword.rend_deta: +%s armor-piercing damage, heals you %s, slows and blinds
item.lacuna.village_coin.tip: Minted from what the land gave up.
item.lacuna.village_ledger.tip: Right click: your standing, the laws and the policy of the village. Placed outside villages, it founds one.
item.lacuna.whisperbone_flute.lore: The dead still know the tune.
item.lacuna.whisperbone_flute.use: Use: call echoes of the recently fallen.
item.lacuna.zenithite_shard.tip: Found only where waterfalls run upward.
lacuna.bag.in_bag: In %s's bag! Jump or attack to struggle · %s s
lacuna.bag.lost: Whatever is in here doesn't exist anymore.
lacuna.bag.no_pvp: PvP is off: no bagging players.
lacuna.bag.op_only: Only an operator in creative mode can bag that.
lacuna.bag.player_busy: They're tangled up with another bag.
lacuna.bag.player_cooldown: %s is still dizzy from the last bag.
lacuna.bag.player_immune: They can't be caught right now.
lacuna.bag.slippery: It slipped out of the bag.
lacuna.bag.too_big: Too big even for this bag.
lacuna.bag.too_much: Too much stuff, the bag isn't so large after all…
lacuna.bag.too_tangled: It's stuck to the rest of itself.
lacuna.bag.wont_fit: That doesn't go in a bag.
lacuna.banish.arrived: The world fades. You stand in the Forgotten Land.
lacuna.banish.returned: The Forgotten Land lets you go.
lacuna.bell.reveal: The bell's toll echoes through the stone: %s ores answer.
lacuna.configuration.title: Lacuna Config
lacuna.confusion.swap: You slipped into one of your copies' places.
lacuna.court.paid: Fine paid: %s coins. Reputation is now %s.
lacuna.court.standing: Standing: %s (%s). Fine to clear it: %s coins. Next pardon in %s days.
lacuna.court.too_soon: The court heard you recently. Come back in a few days.
lacuna.fl.cannot_leave: The Forgotten Land does not let you leave.
lacuna.fl.no_rest: There is no rest in the Forgotten Land.
lacuna.guild.contract_given: The guild hands you a contract.
lacuna.guild.info: %s: right click with %s coins to join (reputation 10+, one guild per person).
lacuna.guild.need_rep: The guild only accepts friends of the village (reputation 10+).
lacuna.guild.wrong_board: This contract belongs to another guild.
lacuna.hourglass.empty: The sand is spent. Feed it a Chronal Shard.
lacuna.hourglass.full: The hourglass cannot hold any more sand.
lacuna.labyrinth.reflection: Something in the mirrors starts to walk your path.
lacuna.lantern.full: The Null Lantern is already fully charged.
lacuna.lantern.out: Your Null Lantern gutters out. Feed it an Ender Pearl or an Echo Shard.
lacuna.lantern.placed_out: A Null Lantern nearby gutters out.
lacuna.message.disabled: This power is dormant on this world.
lacuna.message.feature_failed: Something beyond comprehension went wrong; the power fades.
lacuna.mummy.already: Already wrapped tight. Shears unwrap it.
lacuna.mummy.not_yours: That creature belongs to someone else.
lacuna.mummy.too_mighty: Far too mighty to be wrapped.
lacuna.mummy.wont_hold: The bandage won't hold on that.
lacuna.obelisk.line.0: Here the names were carved so deep that the stone forgot them.
lacuna.obelisk.line.1: We built the city of glass, and the city remembered us instead.
lacuna.obelisk.line.10: We traded our past for a quiet land. The land kept both.
lacuna.obelisk.line.11: The rubies were tears of the mountain. We made crowns of them.
lacuna.obelisk.line.12: Ash falls where snow once did; it remembers footsteps a little longer.
lacuna.obelisk.line.13: The waterfalls turned upward the day the river lost its name.
lacuna.obelisk.line.14: Every festival ended with a song no one could finish.
lacuna.obelisk.line.15: If you hear whispering in the marsh, answer politely.
lacuna.obelisk.line.16: The merchant who still walks remembers every price but his own.
lacuna.obelisk.line.17: Here stood the library. The books are still here; the words left.
lacuna.obelisk.line.18: Eclipse was not the end. It was a door left ajar.
lacuna.obelisk.line.19: Mark the place where you stand: one day it will forget you too.
lacuna.obelisk.line.2: Count the towers. Then count the people. One number is missing.
lacuna.obelisk.line.20: Seven brothers, one obelisk, no names.
lacuna.obelisk.line.21: The glass grows where the light was kindest.
lacuna.obelisk.line.22: The hounds of brass still follow a master who never returns.
lacuna.obelisk.line.23: Read slowly. The letters move when you are not looking.
lacuna.obelisk.line.3: The sun was ours for a thousand summers.
lacuna.obelisk.line.4: Whoever reads this has already forgotten who wrote it.
lacuna.obelisk.line.5: The bells rang under the sea so the drowned would not feel alone.
lacuna.obelisk.line.6: Twelve steps there are one step here.
lacuna.obelisk.line.7: A name is a door. We closed all of ours.
lacuna.obelisk.line.8: The watches still tick in the sand, counting for no one.
lacuna.obelisk.line.9: Do not look for us in the mirrors. Only you live there now.
lacuna.obelisk.reward: Something falls from a crack in the stone.
lacuna.pearl.forgotten_refuses: The Forgotten Land swallows the call.
lacuna.pearl.nothing_answers: The shard hums, but nothing answers.
lacuna.pearl.split: The pearl splits into two halves.
lacuna.pearl.split_ground: The pearl splits; no room left, a half fell at your feet.
lacuna.pearl.split_inventory: The pearl splits; a half went into your inventory (hotbar full).
lacuna.portal.blocked: The opening inside the frames must be clear.
lacuna.portal.incomplete: The ring is incomplete: 8 frames, 2 per side (corners empty), around a 2×2 opening.
lacuna.possess.host.fighting: You fight back against the shadow!
lacuna.possess.host.hint: Struggle to cast it out: move, look away, strike
lacuna.possess.host.seized: A shadow has seized your body!
lacuna.possess.hud.fighting: Your host is fighting back! %s s
lacuna.possess.hud.hint: Move to steer · Attack to strike · Sneak to leave
lacuna.possess.lifeless: That body won't answer to anyone.
lacuna.possess.no_pvp: PvP is off: players can't be possessed.
lacuna.possess.not_yours: That creature belongs to someone else.
lacuna.possess.nothing: There is no soul there to possess.
lacuna.possess.reeling: Your shadow is still reeling (%s s).
lacuna.possess.ridden: It is riding or being ridden.
lacuna.possess.taken: Another shadow already dwells in that body.
lacuna.possess.too_mighty: That soul is far too mighty to possess.
lacuna.possess.untouchable: That player can't be possessed right now.
lacuna.possess.wary: That soul just cast a shadow out and is on its guard.
lacuna.quickening.lost: The spark of life found nothing to wake, and your heart flows back.
lacuna.quickening.no_target: Aim at a dropped item, or hold one in your off hand.
lacuna.quickening.too_weak: Your heart is too faint to share.
lacuna.relic.name: Unreadable Relic
lacuna.relic.scattered: Your belongings were scattered across the overworld near %s %s
lacuna.scepter.too_weak: You are too weak to pay the price.
lacuna.sickle.tide_low: The tide is too low for a maelstrom %s
lacuna.starcaller.no_target: The call finds nothing for a star to fall on.
lacuna.starcaller.too_far: No star can reach that spot.
lacuna.starfall.natural: A star falls beyond the hills, to the %s…
lacuna.suns_fury.fizzles: The sun cannot reach the Forgotten Land.
lacuna.totem.silent: The totem is silent in this dimension.
lacuna.village.council: The council of %s has decreed a new policy: %s.
lacuna.village.founded: You founded a village: %s. Its villagers now live by the civic rules.
lacuna.village.joined: This ledger now keeps the records of %s.
lacuna.village.law.0: No drawn weapons inside the village
lacuna.village.law.2: No breaking blocks inside the village
lacuna.village.law.3: The bell rings only at dawn
lacuna.village.none: This is not part of any village.
lacuna.village.warn.curfew: Curfew! Strangers must be indoors after dusk.
lacuna.village.warn.weapon: Sheathe your weapon inside the village!
lacuna.watch.full: The watch cannot hold more shards.
lacuna.watch.other_dimension: That moment belongs to another world.
lacuna.watch.too_fresh: No moment is old enough to return to.

painting.lacuna.memory_dawn.title: Memory: Dawn over the Spires
painting.lacuna.memory_fall.author: Unknown hand
painting.lacuna.memory_fall.title: Memory: The Fall
painting.lacuna.memory_festival.author: Unknown hand
painting.lacuna.memory_festival.title: Memory: Festival of Lanterns
painting.lacuna.memory_harvest.author: Unknown hand
painting.lacuna.memory_harvest.title: Memory: Harvest Day

painting.lacuna.memory_spire.title: Memory: The Bright Spire
